subject: Stakeholder bridge doc — starter GDoc + slide outline for MAP alignment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Chang <ellis.chang@pioneersys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Stakeholder bridge doc — starter GDoc + slide outline for MAP alignment

Ellis —

Thanks again for the time today. Following up with a lightweight starter artifact to get stakeholder alignment and shorten the evaluation runway. Attached: a seed Google Doc (starter MAP / "stakeholder bridge") and a short slide outline that we can turn into a 2-slide exec brief.

Quick summary of intent:
- Single source of truth for stakeholders and success criteria (tech, security, procurement, product).
- 30-day trial option we discussed (integration -> test -> validation -> go/no-go).
- Clear owners and dates so procurement and engineering can commit.

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the internal stakeholders you want on the MAP (names + roles)?
2) Can you review the Acceptance Criteria section in the GDoc and add any must-have tests for performance/latency/cost?
3) Are there procurement constraints (e.g., PO timeline, security questionnaire owners) we should call out now?

I uploaded: stakeholder-bridge-starter-gdoc (link below) and a slides PDF (quick outline). I'll update the doc with Marissa's input after your notes.

Proposed next steps:
- Ellis reviews and comments (today/tomorrow)
- Connor schedules a 60-min technical review next week to walk the integration checklist
- Marissa to draft a one-page procurement path (PO -> SOC2 evidence -> procurement signature)

Links / attachments:
- [Attachment: stakeholder-bridge-starter-gdoc (Google Doc)]
- [Attachment: map-starter-slides-v1.pdf]

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0217
From: Ellis Chang <ellis.chang@pioneersys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T11:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder bridge doc — starter GDoc + slide outline for MAP alignment

Vivek —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the clear template. I invited our Security lead (Maya R.) to the GDoc and left initial comments in Acceptance Criteria. High-level notes:
- Performance: target 95th pct latency < 450ms for our 2k token test prompts.
- Data handling: must confirm whether KV cache persists across sessions (we have compliance constraints).
- Procurement: our legal team requires a minimal data processing addendum before PII ingestion.

Proposed stakeholder list (internal to Pioneer):
- Ellis Chang — Head of Product (myself)
- Maya R. — Security Lead (maya.rao@pioneersys.com)
- Alex D. — Platform Engineering (alex.dias@pioneersys.com)
- Jenna W. — Procurement (jenna.wong@pioneersys.com)

We can commit to a 30-day pilot but need a clear go/no-go metric on both quality (F1 >= 0.78 on our evaluation set) and latency/cost ceilings. I'll upload a short Pioneer requirements doc to the thread (stub attached).

Also available for a tech review next Tue (Dec 7) morning PST. Would that work for you and Connor?

Thanks,
Ellis Chang
Head of Product — Pioneer Systems
ellis.chang@pioneersys.com | +1 (206) 555-0133

All —

Thanks Ellis, great feedback. I made a pass through the starter GDoc and added:
- a short "Owner & Dates" table with tentative week-by-week milestones (integration window, test cases, eval run, final review).
- an expanded Acceptance Criteria section with the Pioneer test prompts and a proposed sampling methodology.
- a procurement checklist with who to loop for SOC2 evidence and where to request logs.

Suggested 30-day pilot cadence (draft):
- Week 0 (integration prep): credentials, network allowlist, test dataset delivery. Owner: Alex D. / Connor O'Brien
- Week 1 (integration): agent/service integration, smoke tests
- Week 2 (validation): run 10k tokens through evaluation set, measure latency & quality
- Week 3 (tuning): small prompt-engineering passes, quantization profile trial (if needed)
- Week 4 (decision): go/no-go based on agreed cutoffs

Connor — can you pick two 60-min slots next week (Dec 6/7 window) for the tech review? I'll also draft the procurement path and link the doc here when it's ready. Vivek — want me to include a short exec slide (1 slide) summarizing the key risks and the PO timeline?

Attachments: updated-stakeholder-bridge-gdoc (I left comments visible), draft-map-starter-slides-v1.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Marissa / Vivek —

This looks good. Confirming:
- Pioneer will review Marissa's updated doc and we will add the final evaluation metric definitions by Fri (Dec 3).
- Tech review: Tue Dec 7 at 10:00 AM PST works for our team (I invited Connor).
- Procurement: Jenna will start the DPA review once we provide the minimal spec; I asked Legal to prioritize.

Next steps I committed to on our side:
1) Add final Acceptance Criteria into the GDoc by EOD Fri (Dec 3).
2) Share an internal test dataset and expected F1 calculation notebook by Mon (Dec 6).
3) Jenna will start procurement and share PO timing constraints in the doc.

If we hit the cutoffs, Pioneer targets a signed pilot PO within 14 days of a positive decision. I also attached our short requirements doc for reference.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the tech review.

Best,
Ellis Chang
